findings.location: source.html — hymn stanza (final stanza before closing)
findings.source_quote:
Let every tribe and every tongue
That bound creation's call
Now shout in universal song,
The crowned Lord of all!
findings.suggested_fix:
The translation here is inaccurate and ungrammatical ('Que la llamada de la creación ató' is incorrect). Render the four lines in natural Spanish that preserves the original sense and verse breaks. Suggested corrected translation (preserve HTML tags):
"Que cada tribu y cada lengua
que la creación llamó,
ahora clamen en canción universal,
al Señor coronado de todo!"
findings.translation_quote:
Que cada tribu y cada lengua
Que la llamada de la creación ató
Ahora clamen en canción universal,
¡Al Señor coronado de todo!

findings.source_quote: Let high born seraphs tune the lyre, And, as they tune it, fall Before His face who tunes their choir, And crown Him Lord of all!
findings.suggested_fix: The verb 'tune' was translated as 'tunen', which is nonstandard Spanish. Use an appropriate Spanish verb such as 'afinar' or 'entonar' to convey the meaning. Example corrected lines (preserve HTML): "Que los serafines de alta cuna afinen la lira, / y, al afinarla, caigan / ante su rostro, que afina su coro, / ¡y coronadle Señor de todo!"
findings.translation_quote:
Que los serafines de alta cuna tunen la lira,
Y, al afinarla, caigan
Ante Su rostro, que afina su coro,
¡Y coronadle Señor de todo!
